def _handle_enum(self, node, scope, ctxt, stream):
        """Handle enum nodes

        :node: TODO
        :scope: TODO
        :ctxt: TODO
        :stream: TODO
        :returns: TODO

        """
        if node.get('name') in scope:
            self._error(node, 'enum redefined')
        scope[node.get('name')] = node
        self._write('typedef enum {')
        self._write_indent()
        for enum in node.get('enums'):
            self._write('%s,' % enum.get('name'))
        self._write_dedent()
        self._write('} %s;' % node.get('name'))
